entries.title: run_check must survive malformed check commands: an unbalanced quote makes shlex.split raise ValueError outside the try/except, killing the whole night with halt_reason=error; catch it and return a failing CheckResult (ok=False, exit_code=-1) instead

Shell-form pytest checks bypass the documented addopts strip: needs_shell commands like 'pytest tests/test_ok.py -q && echo ok' run under /bin/sh without -o addopts=, so a pytest.ini --cov still kills the check; insert -o addopts= after each pytest invocation in the shell branch, matching the README safety contract
